from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial data extracted from a single document."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name this document reports on")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/securities code if present")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    credit_impairment_loss: float | None = Field(description="Credit impairment loss amount; None if not reported in this document")
    amount_quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the credit impairment loss value or line")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
